verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy-posture question for an agentic commerce platform that handles buyer, cart, and order data, so the axis applies. The pack only describes object lifecycles: carts have a long TTL, checkouts are short-lived, tokens expire after 60 minutes, and a cancel_cart tool exists. None of this is a user- or agent-facing control over retention periods or deletion of personal or order data, so there is no evidence the story is delivered.
